01 Who we are

We sit between the mine and the market. For more than a decade Mako Mining has turned verified production into delivered contracts, on terms both sides can trust.

We are a facilitator, not a miner. That means one accountable desk for the whole trade, from the first assay to the final bill of lading. No handoffs, no gaps, no surprises.

Producers get a route to serious buyers and clean payment. Buyers get verified material, correct documentation and reliable delivery. We carry the risk in the middle.

02 What we do

One desk, from source to delivery.

01

Sourcing

We verify producers at the source. Assays, provenance, volumes and offtake, all confirmed before a single tonne moves. If the material is not what it claims to be, it never reaches a buyer.

02

Facilitation

Contracts, compliance, finance and inspection. We structure the trade and carry the paperwork so both sides can sign with confidence and know exactly where they stand.

03

Delivery

Freight, customs and documentation, to port or to plant. Every consignment is tracked from the pit face to the buyer, with one team answerable for the whole route.
